applicability: Family coverage and membership outcomes returned by the ordinary curator ingest report.
conditions: Added, reused and retired describe membership edges; retainedFromMemberId identifies the old membership that selected an unchanged invariant revision.
A recorded successor roster’s unchangedSiblingMembers count includes explicitly retained revisions while distinguishing genuinely new member endpoints.
Recorded counts require post-batch stored facts. Projected or not-recorded coverage leaves unmeasured member counts null.
An exact replay reports already-stored edges as reused and preserves their exact endpoints.
exclusions: These counts and states are not a semantic verdict, test certificate or complete-project coverage claim.
The caller still checks the selected publication result and reads the exact published roster; a projected report is not publication.
statement: Curator coverage distinguishes newly added membership edges from retained invariant revisions and leaves uncommitted member counts unmeasured.
